_comment: Simulator-only test scenarios for RetailCIFInquiry, keyed by test CIF (as returned by the matching GetCifByAccountNumber scenario entries). Looked up by ConnectController before falling back to the default RetailCIFInquiry.json. See TestScenarios.md. Entries below 80000001 predate this pass (2026-08-08); PrefFlag was added to those entries' PhoneEmailInfo records on 2026-08-17 (they previously had none — the current application code requires PrefFlag=Y on the matched record, so these would otherwise no longer resolve a mobile/email). CIF 70000001-70000007 (stakeholder samples) and 80000001-80000023 (derived edge cases) were added 2026-08-17. 2026-09-03: the 6 Guardian mocks 19990001-19990006 had a RetCustAddrInfo shape identical to Mock G (19990007) EXCEPT for PrefFormat/CountryCode/StateCode/CityCode — since PersonalInformation.cshtml.cs's OnPostCheckGuardianAccountDetail only resolves Municipality/Ward Number when PrefFormat=='STRUCTURED_FORMAT' (Country/District resolve unconditionally from CountryCode/CityCode, which these 6 also lacked), only Mock G actually exercised the full address cascade before this fix — the other 6 silently left Municipality/Ward (and, via the missing CityCode, District/Country) blank regardless of any Search Guardian mapping code. Added the same already-proven values Mock G already used (STRUCTURED_FORMAT / NP / 3 / 306), purely additive — each mock's own deliberate NATID/EntityDocDtls test gap (no-NATID on 19990001, unmappable PlaceOfIssue on 19990004, missing DocIssueDt on 19990005, missing all NATID fields on 19990006) is untouched.

19990001._derived: GD-NATID-TEST-A (2026-08-18) — Existing Guardian search / no-NATID case (account 55509990001). EntityDocDtls deliberately has NO NATID-containing DocCode (BIRTHCERT/PASSPORT only) — Guardian's National ID section/upload must SHOW and stay required. Town uses the exact same spelling already proven elsewhere in this simulator (CorporateCifInquiry_old.json) rather than a guessed/corrected one, to maximize the chance it matches real Municipality static data.

19990002._derived: GD-NATID-TEST-B / MOCK A — COMPLETE NID (2026-08-26, extended) — Existing Guardian search / with-NATID control case (account 55509990002). EntityDocDtls DOES include a NATID DocCode — Guardian's National ID upload must be HIDDEN and not required (NID Number/District/Date stay visible per the approved rule). RefNum/PlaceOfIssue/DocIssueDt added (2026-08-26): the original entry only ever exercised the has-NATID boolean branch — RefNum/PlaceOfIssue/DocIssueDt were absent, so the actual field-population/text_two-mapping code path was never reachable through this scenario. PlaceOfIssue uses '306' — confirmed live against the current restored CAO-UATDB (tbl_static_data type='DISTRICT', text='KATHMANDU', text_two='306') that Issue District's text_two column is a numeric CBS district CODE, not the district NAME — matches the already-established GetDistrictIdByCodeAsyc(primaryAddr.CityCode) precedent used for address resolution, not a new convention.

19990003._derived: MOCK B — DIFFERENT DISTRICT (2026-08-26) — account 55509990003. Same shape as Mock A but PlaceOfIssue='207' (tbl_static_data type='DISTRICT', text='BARA', text_two='207', confirmed live against current CAO-UATDB). Purpose: prove the PlaceOfIssue->text_two mapping is genuinely dynamic, not hard-coded to Kathmandu.

19990111._derived: IDENTITY-UAT-CUSTOMER (2026-08-27, extended same day with BRCD) — dedicated Existing Customer for full Individual Customer Portal Identity Verification CBS-mapping UAT (account 55509990111). Mobile/Email match the values quoted for Existing Customer verification. EntityDocDtls carries one entry per supported document type (NATID/CITZ/PP/PAN/VOTID/BRCD) with RefNum/PlaceOfIssue/DocIssueDt/CountryOfIssue populated, so National ID/Citizenship/Passport/PAN/Voter ID/Minor Birth Registration all map on Identity Verification and their matching document uploads become optional. PlaceOfIssue='306' reuses the same confirmed-live KATHMANDU text_two code the 19990002/19990003 entries above already proved resolves correctly (tbl_static_data type='DISTRICT', text='KATHMANDU', text_two='306') — not a new/guessed code. CountryOfIssue='NP' for Passport so the existing Nepal/non-Nepal Passport District rule applies (District IS expected to resolve for this customer). BRCD's RefNum/PlaceOfIssue(405)/DocIssueDt/CountryOfIssue(NP) values match the exact real CBS sample supplied for this fix — this customer's own IsMinor='N' does not gate BRCD mapping (that's driven by the APPLICATION's own account_holder_type-derived Is_Minor, not this field), so BRCD is exercised by linking this same CIF to a Minor-type test application.

19990121._derived: IDENTITY-UAT-NID-ONLY (2026-08-28) — account 55509990121. National ID DocCode=NATID only, so document-optionality is provably per-section (not a single global CBS flag).

19990123._derived: IDENTITY-UAT-PASSPORT-ONLY (2026-08-28) — account 55509990123. Passport DocCode=PP only, deliberately no expiry field (RetailCIFInquiry's EntityDocDtls has no expiry property at all — confirmed against RetCustInqResponse.cs) — Expiry AD/BS must stay manual/required.

19990124._derived: IDENTITY-UAT-VOTERID-ONLY (2026-08-28) — account 55509990124. Voter ID DocCode=VOTID only.

The matching test application must be created as Minor (Is_Minor is application-derived, not read from this record's own IsMinor field) for BRCD mapping/optionality to apply.

Passport (CountryOfIssue=IN, confirmed live tbl_static_data COUNTRY text_two='IN'->INDIA) so the existing non-Nepal-Passport Visa-applicability rule evaluates true, plus VISA. No fabricated Visa expiry field (RetailCIFInquiry provides none) — Visa Expiry AD/BS stay manual/required.

19990004._derived: MOCK C — UNMAPPABLE PLACE (2026-08-26) — account 55509990004. PlaceOfIssue='TEST UNKNOWN DISTRICT' — deliberately not numeric, guaranteed to never match any tbl_static_data DISTRICT text_two (all confirmed numeric, e.g. '306'/'207'). Purpose: prove no random/fuzzy-matched district is ever selected — Issue District must remain unselected (or keep the DB value if one already exists) when the mapping genuinely has no match.

19990005._derived: MOCK D — PARTIAL CBS (2026-08-26) — account 55509990005. NID Number + PlaceOfIssue present, DocIssueDt deliberately OMITTED. Purpose: prove field-level CBS fallback — a DB row with Number/District saved but Issue Date missing should have ONLY the missing date field filled from CBS, per DB-first field-by-field rule.

19990006._derived: MOCK E — NO NID DATA (2026-08-26) — account 55509990006. NATID DocCode present (Guardian_Has_Cbs_NatId_Document = true, so the upload control still correctly hides) but RefNum/PlaceOfIssue/DocIssueDt all absent. Purpose: prove the system does not fabricate/overwrite DB data when CBS confirms a NATID exists but returns no actual field values — existing DB values (if any) must be left exactly as they were.

19990007._derived: MOCK G — ADULT GUARDIAN, POSITIVE CASE (2026-08-26). See matching GetCifByAccountNumber.scenarios.json entry (account 55509990007) for why this was needed: every prior GD-NATID Mock (19990001-19990006) reused the original template's BirthDt='2015-08-26', a deliberately-MINOR customer, so all of them fail the >=18 Guardian check by design — that check is correct and was left untouched. This is a genuinely separate, isolated adult record. BirthDt='1990-05-15' (age 36 as of 2026-08-26, confirmed >=18). PlaceOfIssue='306' confirmed live against current CAO-UATDB (tbl_static_data type='DISTRICT', text='KATHMANDU', text_two='306', value=28) before use, not assumed.
